correctness.rationale: For each row N the Markov chain has renewal return tail (k+1)^(-beta_N), beta_N=1+c/log N>0. The last-renewal identity P(A_N=k)=u_(N,N-k)(k+1)^(-beta_N) follows exactly. Stochastic monotonicity of the transition makes renewal mass u_(N,m) nonincreasing. The B_N(e^(-t/N))/log N -> h(c) logarithmic Riemann sum, Laplace-transform continuity of locally finite tilted renewal measures, and monotonicity give h(c)log N*u_(N,floor Nx)->1 uniformly on compact x>0. Ages k=N^s, s in (0,1), then yield tilted-log density e^(-cs)/h(c), with endpoint tightness. Exact future survival ((k+1)/(k+r+1))^beta_N yields independent Pareto-II residual ratio conditional on ages diverging. Independently recomputed exact renewal convolutions for N=1500, c=-1,0,1 and normalization exactly 1; finite-size log-age CDFs approach predicted values slowly, not an infinite proof.
